name: Ogi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogi city emblem in blue, green and orange: a blue ring open at the top with a green stylised flame and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ogi, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 March 2006.

features.role: Ogi city emblem — a blue ring open at the top with a green stylised flame and an orange disc
